The Space:

Discover the charm of Whimsy, offering a spacious and designer-grade beach experience on the picturesque 30A!

Positioned conveniently less than a half a mile from 30A’s newest beach access, reachable in under 90 seconds via a golf cart, Whimsy ensures easy access to Florida’s famous sugar sand beaches!

With over 6 beach accesses within a mile, variety becomes your companion, ensuring endless options to bask in the sun.

Whimsy boasts 8 bedrooms, each with its own attached bath, comfortably accommodating up to 19 guests, all while maintaining its carefully curated coastal-chic style.

After a day at the beach, rejuvenate in Whimsy’s private pool or unwind in its inviting splash pad. As the evening unfolds, relish the coastal breeze from Whimsy’s covered 4th-story deck.

Built in 2023, Whimsy is far from your average rental, featuring state-of-the-art amenities for your comfort and convenience. Expect designer-grade furnishings, top-quality mattresses, and state of the art appliances and bedding for a contemporary and comfortable stay.

Whether you're preparing a special group meal or enjoying grab-n-go convenience, Whimsy offers versatile dining options, including indoor dining for 18 and al-fresco tables.

Visiting off-season? Take advantage of Whimsy’s seasonally-heated pool (October 1 and April 30) at no extra charge.

Explore 30A’s famous 17-mile coastal path. Prefer a more leisurely ride? Hop on the complimentary eco-friendly six-seater golf cart to discover renowned restaurants and boutiques along Florida’s Emerald Coast.

Whimsy goes beyond your typical rental by providing two free paddleboards, allowing you to experience the serenity of our Coastal Dune lakes less than a half mile away.

Craft enduring memories with your loved ones and immerse yourself in the distinctive coastal experience that Whimsy offers, elevating your stay beyond the ordinary beach house rental.

Important Information:
NOTE: Check in time is 4:00 PM CST. Check out time is 10:00 AM CST. Our staff needs time to properly clean, sanitize, inspect and maintain the property. Because the property is extremely heavily booked we are unable to offer early check ins, late check outs, early parking or luggage drop offs. Additionally, VRBO's insurance only covers the property and the Guest between the property’s published check in time of 4:00 PM CST and check out time of 10:00 AM CST.

NOTE: Guests are not permitted to have anything shipped or mailed (through a carrier such as USPS, UPS, or Fedex) to the property. Please be aware that the property does not have postal service and your packages will most likely be returned by the carrier.

NOTE: Guests are not permitted to have local deliveries (such as baby gear, beach chairs/gear, groceries, golf carts) made prior to their check-in time of 4:00 PM CST and are not permitted to have local pick-ups made after their check-out time of 10:00 AM CST.

NOTE: If you would like to reserve more than 11 months in advance, you must use the VRBO website, rather than the VRBO app. The VRBO app only shows the calendar for up to 11 months which means that it can only be used for reservations less than a year away. Parties or events not allowed Thanks!

NOTE: This property is available for vacation rental only. Parties are strictly prohibited.

NOTE: AGE REQUIREMENTS. You must be at least 25 years old to reserve
during Spring Break. Sorry, there are no exceptions.

NOTE: A security camera is mounted on the outside of the house and is aimed down the driveway. The pool/pool area is not within the camera’s field of vision.

NOTE: The property has an exterior security camera(s) that face the driveway and/or entrance and smoke detectors throughout the property. Tampering with the exterior security camera(s) or smoke detector on the property is a violation of the booking agreement. Guests will be charged a $500 fine for tampering with the security camera(s) or smoke detector(s) and the reservation will be cancelled immediately without a refund.

NOTE: Sorry, no pets. No emotional support animals (ESA). No exceptions. Many of our Guests have pet allergies and rely on us to provide a pet free environment. Bringing a pet or an emotional support animal (ESA) is a violation of your booking agreement that will result in the cancellation of your reservation without refund.

NOTE: Smoking is strictly prohibited inside the house. This includes cigarettes, cigars, marijuana, etc. A $500-1000 additional cleaning charge will be added to remove the smell of smoke from the house.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
